allyeffect.configuration.activateOnlyInR: If true, the effect only activates when another entity is within range (Default: true)
allyeffect.configuration.effectAnimation: The animation style for the ally effect (Default: HUG)
allyeffect.configuration.effectRange.too: The range the ally effect checks for other entities (Default: 3)
allyeffect.configuration.giverEffectFreq: The frequency (in ticks) at which the giver entity receives the effect (Default: 20)
allyeffect.configuration.passiveEffectEn: If true, the passive effect is enabled (Default: false)
allyeffect.configuration.passiveEffectFr: The frequency (in ticks) at which the passive effect is applied (Default: 20)
allyeffect.configuration.passiveEffectRa: The range the passive effect checks for other entities (Default: 5)
allyeffect.configuration.receiverEffectF: The frequency (in ticks) at which the receiver entity receives the effect (Default: 20)
